name: Jotaro vs a street thug
description: The tutorial-tier fight. A trash mob is allowed to be a guaranteed win; what is not allowed is for it to take as long as a boss.

name: Jotaro and Kakyoin vs the Flame Assassin and a thug
description: Mid-tier encounter. Two party members short of a full team, so it is the first fight where a wasted turn should be able to cost the run.

name: Full party vs Dio and the Flame Assassin
description: The encounter that is actually playable in Godot today, and the one the first manual playthrough lost with Dio still on 389 of 1520 HP. Its band is the M2 exit criterion in numeric form.
